# Order-free FUSE on the paper's Best-of-N data (generated by scripts/run_order_free_bon.py)

Selection accuracy (%). Random order = the verifier columns permuted (same permutation for every query), mean [min-max] over 3 orders. GPQA-70B and GPQA-Diamond-70B are skipped: their dataset is no longer on Hugging Face.
